mapper.select:
select r.id, r.lastname, r.loginid, r.workcode, r.mobile, r.departmentid as department_id, d.departmentname as department_name, r.subcompanyid1 as subcompany_id, s.subcompanyname as subcompany_name, r.status, r.accounttype as account_type from hrmresource r left join hrmdepartment d on d.id = r.departmentid left join hrmsubcompany s on s.id = r.subcompanyid1 where (r.status is null or r.status < 4) and (r.accounttype is null or r.accounttype = 0)
and (r.lastname like #{keyword} or r.loginid like #{keyword} or r.workcode like #{keyword} or r.mobile like #{keyword} or cast(r.id as varchar(20)) like #{keyword})
order by r.departmentid, r.id

select r.id, r.lastname, r.loginid, r.workcode, r.mobile, r.departmentid as department_id, d.departmentname as department_name, r.subcompanyid1 as subcompany_id, s.subcompanyname as subcompany_name, r.status, r.accounttype as account_type from hrmresource r left join hrmdepartment d on d.id = r.departmentid left join hrmsubcompany s on s.id = r.subcompanyid1 where r.id = #{id}
